name: professional
label: Professional
css: .style-professional { background-color: var(--slide-surface, #FFFFFF); color: var(--slide-text, #111827); font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif; width: 1080px; height: 1080px; padding: 64px; box-sizing: border-box; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; position: relative; overflow: hidden; } .style-professional::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; width: 400px; height: 400px; background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #FECE14), transparent 70%); opacity: 0.08; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; } .style-professional .hook { font-size: 80px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); max-width: 90%; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .style-professional .text { font-size: 50px; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.3; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); max-width: 85%; margin: 32px 0 0 0; padding: 0; } .style-professional .step { position: absolute; top: 32px; right: 32px; font-size: 160px; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; color: var(--slide-primary, #FECE14); opacity: 0.12; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .style-professional .brand { position: absolute; bottom: 32px; left: 32px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.05em; color: var(--slide-text, #111827); opacity: 0.7; text-transform: uppercase; } .slide-code.style-professional { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #1a1a1a 0%, #2d2d2d 100%); color: #FFFFFF; } .slide-code.style-professional .hook, .slide-code.style-professional .text { color: #FFFFFF; } .slide-code.style-professional .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #FECE14); opacity: 0.15; } .slide-code.style-professional .brand { color: #FFFFFF; opacity: 0.6; } .slide-code.style-professional::before { background: radial-gradient(circle, var(--slide-primary, #FECE14), transparent 70%); opacity: 0.06; } .slide-insight.style-professional { background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0f172a 0%, #1e293b 100%); color: #FFFFFF; } .slide-insight.style-professional .hook { color: var(--slide-primary, #FECE14); text-shadow: 0 0 30px rgba(254, 206, 20, 0.2); } .slide-insight.style-professional .text { color: #e2e8f0; } .slide-insight.style-professional .insight-text { font-size: 48px; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.4; color: #FFFFFF; background: rgba(254, 206, 20, 0.1); border-left: 4px solid var(--slide-primary, #FECE14); padding: 24px 24px 24px 20px; border-radius: 4px; margin: 24px 0; } .slide-insight.style-professional .step { color: var(--slide-primary, #FECE14); opacity: 0.12; } .slide-insight.style-professional .brand { color: #94a3b8; opacity: 0.8; }
